# Vojislav Miloradovic - Machine-Readable Credentials Archive

> **Last Generated:** 2026-08-31 20:55 UTC
> Curated, structured, and token-optimized record of professional certifications, badges, and learning achievements across Microsoft Learn, AWS, Google Cloud, Credly, LinkedIn, and Google Developer.

## Portfolio Overview & Total Counts
- **Microsoft Learn**: 35,801 completed units | 4,825 total achievements | 6,020,950 XP
- **Google Cloud Skills**: 386 badges
- **AWS Skill Builder**: 741 completed courses/activities
- **Credly**: 591 credentials
- **LinkedIn**: 1,588 verified external certifications
- **Google Developer**: 172 milestone badges | 1,601 codelabs & activities
